summary.text: Steve Gist is a Republican state representative from Montana who has represented House District 25 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A registered nurse who co-operates a wildland fire contracting business, he chairs the House Natural Resources Committee.

paragraphs.text: Steve Gist's career experience includes working as a registered nurse and co-operating a wildland fire contracting business.
Gist defeated incumbent Democrat Jasmine Krotkov in the November 3, 2020 general election for House District 25 and assumed office on January 4, 2021.
He won re-election in 2022, again over Krotkov, and in 2024, defeating James Rickley.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the House Natural Resources Committee and is assigned to the House Local Government and Business and Labor committees.
